title: Tabulation (Bottom-Up)
definition: A Bottom-Up DP approach that uses iteration (loops) instead of recursion. It builds a table (array) starting from the absolute smallest subproblem up to the final answer. Avoids the risk of Stack Overflow.
simpleExplanation: Building a staircase from the bottom step up to the top, rather than standing at the top and asking people below you how they got there.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for Tabulation.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to Tabulation to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert Tabulation into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using Tabulation.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of Tabulation from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
